knowledge.title: The Essential Minerals: Nature’s Protective Palette
knowledge.content:
When we discuss mineral ingredients, we are looking at a select group of elemental powerhouses that offer unique benefits for skin health and appearance. At OBSESSED, we treat these ingredients with the reverence of an alchemist, ensuring each handcrafted batch maintains its potent efficacy.
Zinc Oxide: Often hailed as the gold standard of mineral protection, Zinc Oxide acts as a physical shield against UV rays. Beyond its protective qualities, it is renowned for its anti-inflammatory properties, making it an ideal choice for those with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin.
Titanium Dioxide: This naturally occurring mineral provides exceptional opacity and luminosity. It offers a smooth, weightless finish that blurs imperfections while providing additional broad-spectrum defense.
Iron Oxides: These are the pigments of the earth. Unlike synthetic dyes, iron oxides are highly resistant to moisture and are exceptionally gentle on the skin, providing the rich, sophisticated hues found in our premium palettes.
Mica: The secret to that coveted inner glow. Ethically sourced Mica provides a delicate shimmer and silkiness, reflecting light to create a youthful, multidimensional radiance.

knowledge.content: The foundation of a wellness-focused beauty routine lies in the purity of the ingredients.
